gate: G3(b) + evaluator variance + G2 layer2 + G2 layer3 — repaired
order_rationale: G3(b) is the only gate whose firing forces regeneration of the narratives, so it runs first; every layer-2/3 call made before it would be discarded if it fired.

controls.name: negative: neutralised text has 0 gender tokens

g3b.non_independence: 3 candidates per cell share one census row
g3b.pre_declared_caveat: REWRITTEN after neutralisation. Before it, the evaluator was at CEILING by construction (pronouns); the earlier caveat claimed the opposite. With gender surface removed and the census attributes held fixed, the two texts of a pair are near-paraphrases, so the evaluator sits near chance BY CONSTRUCTION: a non-firing G3(b) is WEAK EVIDENCE, never evidence of absence of caricature.

arms.control_inverted: PRIMARY control — same prompt, fields and length
arms.control_shuffled: sentence-level recombination across agents: same genre, register, length and vocabulary, no coherent person
arms.control_no_narrative: DEMOTED — 415-418 words vs 241-256 (1.7x) and a different genre entirely (behaviour instructions). Kept only as an explicitly non-matched floor reading.

layer2.quote_verification: substring after project normalisation; unverifiable = discarded
layer2.pre_declared_limit: control_inverted is near-paraphrase (too strong) and control_no_narrative is another genre (too weak), so layer 2 may yield a floor and a ceiling rather than a decision.
layer2.variance_probe: 3 calls on one text first; if the frozen evaluator is deterministic, the >=2/3 rule is decorative and this drops to 24 calls

layer3.redaction_note: 'building' and 'training' removed from the list: they sit on B.3
layer3.threshold: DESCRIPTIVE — exact counts, no gate, no implicit alpha

Weekly hours fall between thirty-one and forty-eight, spent entirely at a workplace rather than at home. A degree-level or higher qualification underpins the position. The commute, made by car or van, covers between ten and twenty kilometres each way across the South East. Home is a terraced house owned with a mortgage, situated in a suburban part of the South East. The household consists of one person aged under sixty-five, living alone and never married or in a registered civil partnership. The property has two or more bedrooms beyond what a single occupant requires, leaving considerable spare room that can be turned over to storage, a study or guest use.
